title: Davis says Puthoff interviewed Brad Sorensen
summary: UAPGerb tells of Davis says Puthoff interviewed Brad Sorensen, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: cut off, well, Hal Putoff interviewed Brad Sorenson.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest who goes by the name UAPGerb passes on something he says he heard from a man named Eric Davis: that Hal Puthoff, another figure in the world of UFO research, once interviewed a man named Brad Sorensen. The remark comes out half cut off, with no place or date given. It matters to listeners as a clue about who has spoken to whom inside this small circle of people.
